physical_detector_floor.label: Physical detector floor
physical_detector_floor.description: Uses detector output noise with total input power set by source_amplitude² per source channel. Voxel-density modalities are saved as voxel-integrated transfer functions.

empirical_observed_snr.label: Empirical observed SNR
empirical_observed_snr.description: Uses Frobenius(SVD)/observed_SNR and normalizes away raw forward gain.

empirical_anchored.label: Empirically anchored
empirical_anchored.description: EEG only. Excludes near-boundary BEM artifact voxels, then pins the best spatial mode to the literature single-channel SNR × the √N_eff array gain (N_eff ≈ 32 independent channels under correlated EEG noise); the lead-field spectrum shape spreads it across the rest. Only the shape is used, not the unreliable absolute BEM gain. Uses the cached 256-channel lead field, so it is a single anchored estimate rather than a per-layout sweep.
